BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What can you tell me about tidal movements and currents off the coast of Copenhagen, Denmark? ASSISTANT:

The Baltic Sea has a semi-circular shape and is affected by tides. The strongest currents in the Baltic Sea are located near the exit to the Gulf of Bothnia. In the southern part of the Baltic Sea, the currents are weaker and the water is calmer. The offshore waters near Copenhagen, Denmark are affected by the North Sea and its tidal movements.
